# mdns_lite v0.9.2 - Table of Contents

> A simple, no frills mDNS implementation in Elixir

## Pages

- [MdnsLite](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [MdnsLite](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.md): MdnsLite is a simple, limited, no frills mDNS implementation
- [MdnsLite.Cache](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.Cache.md): Cache for records received over mDNS

- [MdnsLite.CoreMonitor](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.CoreMonitor.md): Core logic for network monitors
- [MdnsLite.DNS](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.DNS.md): Bring Erlang's DNS record definitions into Elixir

- [MdnsLite.DNSBridge](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.DNSBridge.md): DNS server that responds to mDNS queries
- [MdnsLite.InetMonitor](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.InetMonitor.md): Network monitor that uses Erlang's :inet functions
- [MdnsLite.Info](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.Info.md): Inspect internal MdnsLite state
- [MdnsLite.Options](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.Options.md): MdnsLite options
- [MdnsLite.VintageNetMonitor](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/MdnsLite.VintageNetMonitor.md): Network monitor that using VintageNet

## Mix Tasks

- [mix mdns_lite.install](https://mdns-lite.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.MdnsLite.Install.md): Installs mdns_lite in your Nerves project.
